feature: V4 core data structures — CandidateSet, InvestigationBrief, InvestigationState, InvestigationTrace
problem: V4 architecture (three pipelines, governed agent) requires typed data structures that flow between pipelines and stages. V3 has ad-hoc dataclasses in orchestrator.py (BudgetState, SuspectCommit, ToolCallRecord, BugAttributionReport) but nothing for V4 concepts: CandidateSet (input pipeline output), InvestigationBrief (Stage 2 output), InvestigationState (harness-managed), CompletionCriteria (brief-driven exit), InvestigationTrace (structured investigation record with 7 nested record types). Without these, no downstream V4 task (governance, retrieval, harness) can be built.
proposed_solution: New src/commit_investigator/models/ package with three modules: candidates.py (CandidateSet, CandidateCommit), investigation.py (InvestigationBrief, Hypothesis, ExaminationStep, InvestigationState, CompletionCriteria, BudgetState), trace.py (InvestigationTrace + HypothesisRecord, EliminationRecord, EvidenceRecord, StrategyRecord, TurnRecord, OutcomeRecord). All dataclasses with to_dict()/from_dict() JSON serialization. Unit tests for construction, defaults, and round-trip serialization. Models package is self-contained — no imports from V3 orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: src/commit_investigator/models/__init__.py exists and re-exports all public model types (CandidateSet, CandidateCommit, InvestigationBrief, Hypothesis, ExaminationStep, InvestigationState, CompletionCriteria, BudgetState, InvestigationTrace, HypothesisRecord, EliminationRecord, EvidenceRecord, StrategyRecord, TurnRecord, OutcomeRecord)

AC2: CandidateSet and CandidateCommit dataclasses match system-specification.md field definitions — CandidateCommit has commit_id (str), rank (int), retrieval_signal (str), summary (str), files_changed (list[str]), date (str); CandidateSet has commits (list[CandidateCommit]), retrieval_metadata (dict), temporal_bound (str)

AC3: InvestigationBrief dataclass with hypotheses (list[Hypothesis]), examination_plan (list[ExaminationStep]), success_criteria (CompletionCriteria), strategy (str), max_effort (int) defaulting to 18 per mechanism-design ADR §Q5

AC4: CompletionCriteria dataclass with defaults: evidence_threshold=3, hypothesis_coverage=2, confidence_gate=0.60, brief_satisfaction=False, budget_hard_stop=False — matching mechanism-design ADR §Q5 values exactly

AC5: InvestigationState dataclass with current_stage (int), candidates_examined (int), candidates_total (int), hypotheses_tested (int), hypotheses_confirmed (int), evidence_quotes_collected (int), re_plan_count (int), budget_used (BudgetState), brief (InvestigationBrief | None)

AC6: InvestigationTrace dataclass with all nested record types matching mechanism-design ADR §Q4 — HypothesisRecord (id, statement, status, reason, stage, turn), EliminationRecord (commit_id, reason, turn, hypothesis_id), EvidenceRecord (commit_id, quote, grounded, hypothesis_id, turn), StrategyRecord (decision, rationale, stage, turn, alternatives_considered), TurnRecord (turn, tool_calls, hypothesis_updates, completion_check), OutcomeRecord (suspect_count, top_confidence, degraded, degraded_reason, hit_at_5, mrr)

AC7: All model types have to_dict() → dict and from_dict(data: dict) → Self round-trip JSON serialization; json.dumps(model.to_dict()) produces valid JSON; Model.from_dict(json.loads(json_str)) reconstructs equivalent instance

AC8: tests/test_models.py with tests covering: construction with all defaults, default value assertions for max_effort=18 and CompletionCriteria thresholds, round-trip JSON (to_dict → from_dict → to_dict produces identical output) for every top-level model type (CandidateSet, InvestigationBrief, InvestigationState, InvestigationTrace)
AC9: Models package has zero imports from commit_investigator.agent — self-contained, no circular dependencies
AC10: pytest tests/ passes — all existing tests (165+) plus new model tests
edge_cases: E1: CandidateSet with empty commits list — construction succeeds, to_dict() produces valid JSON with empty list
E2: InvestigationTrace with all optional/nullable fields set to None — round-trip preserves None values correctly
E3: CompletionCriteria with custom thresholds (non-default values) — from_dict() respects provided values over defaults
verification_method: Evaluator runs: (1) python -c 'from commit_investigator.models import CandidateSet, InvestigationBrief, InvestigationState, InvestigationTrace' to verify imports; (2) pytest tests/test_models.py -v to verify all model tests pass; (3) pytest tests/ to verify no regressions; (4) rg 'from commit_investigator.agent' src/commit_investigator/models/ to verify no V3 imports; (5) wc -l on each model file to verify ≤300 lines; (6) spot-check default values in Python REPL.
